# awscc_athena_system_tables (Resource)

Resource schema for AWS::Athena::SystemTables. Manages the account-level System Tables configuration. System Tables is a single account-wide switch: the reserved name ALL turns all system tables on; the existence of the configuration is the switch.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `table_name` (String) The reserved keyword identifying the account-level System Tables configuration. The only accepted value is ALL, which enables all system tables for the account. This is the resource's primary identifier.

### Optional

- `kms_key_arn` (String) The ARN of the customer managed AWS KMS key used to encrypt the system table data. Specify a key ARN (not an alias); the key must be in the same account and Region. The encryption choice is permanent for the account and Region: it cannot be changed or removed after creation, and it persists after this resource is deleted.
- `tags` (Attributes List) An array of key-value pairs to apply to the system tables configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the configuration was created, set by the service.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_modified_at` (String) The time the configuration was last modified, set by the service.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_athena_system_tables.example
  identity = {
    table_name = "table_name"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `table_name` (String) The reserved keyword identifying the account-level System Tables configuration

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_athena_system_tables.example
  id = "table_name"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_athena_system_tables.example "table_name"
```
